#36324 (Schwarz reflection for completedRiemannZeta₀) — reviewed by @SnirBroshi, all suggestions applied, squashed to 1 commit, rebased on current master, fork CI fully green (Build + Lint + all post-steps). Awaiting workflow approval from a maintainer to run the full CI. Happy to address any further feedback.

#36865 (analytic order at zero with vanishing value) — 9 lines, placed in Order.lean per review guidance from @wwylele on #36778. Fork CI green.

#36871 (nonvanishing in punctured neighborhood from derivative) — 12 lines, placed in Order.lean. Fork CI green.

#36881 (logarithmic residue at simple zeros) — 22 lines, restated with logDeriv and placed in LogDeriv.lean per @wwylele's review. Fork CI green.

The last three are the split PRs from #36778, following @wwylele's suggestion to place each result in its natural home rather than a new file. All four PRs show "3 workflows awaiting approval" — I believe this is the new-contributor workflow gate.

Thanks for your time! and happy to make any changes needed.

I've gone ahead and approved the workflows. Note however that they are all "non-essential"; the CI workflows that matter are the ones that run automatically.

(Also note that if you format PR numbers like #<number> (without extra markdown around it) then they'll be linkified automatically, making it easier for readers to jump to the GitHub PR.)

Thank you @Bryan Gin-ge Chen — appreciate the workflow approval and the formatting tip! Will use plain #36324 style going forward.

Good to know the essential CI runs automatically. All four PRs show green on Build + Lint. Standing by for any review feedback.

To be direct: I use Claude (Anthropic) as a research and writing assistant throughout my workflow. Here's the breakdown for these PRs:

Mathematical content: The theorems and proof strategies (Schwarz reflection via Mellin representation, composing with the functional equation for the critical-line results) are from my research programme. The mathematical ideas are mine.

Lean code: Written with AI assistance — I work interactively with Claude to develop the proof terms, debug type errors, and iterate on tactic proofs. I then verify everything compiles locally with lake env lean before pushing.

Zulip messages: Drafted with AI assistance.

PR descriptions: Written with AI assistance.

I should have disclosed this upfront per the contribution guidelines. That's on me. Happy to add an explicit note to each PR description if that's the expected practice, and to follow whatever the community's preferred disclosure format is going forward.
Yes, per the contribution guidelines you should disclose this in the PR descriptions, thanks
Done — added AI disclosure to the descriptions of all four PRs (#36324, #36865, #36871, #36881). Thanks for the guidance @Snir Broshi.
